title: lightusd stage saved as .usda, .usdc and .usdz, read by lightusd and usd-core
summary: lightusd 1.0.0 authors Xform, Cube, Sphere, a material binding and a time-sampled translate, saves three formats, and lightusd and usd-core 26.11 read them equal. Rerun .usda and .usdz are byte-identical. No rendering.
